name: text
description: Text with structure: paragraphs, headings, lists, emphasis, links, code and captioned tables, written as Markdown. Blank lines start a new paragraph.

use.when: sentences, and anything longer: an explanation, an introduction, a note with its own headings and lists; frame bare.
use.not: a title, which is a heading, or short items, which are a list.
use.with: a heading before it when it starts a section.

content.description: Markdown: paragraphs, headings with #, lists with - or 1., *emphasis*, [links](/t/note), code, and tables. A line starting Table: just above a table is its caption.

level.title: Heading level of a # line
level.description: What a # heading in the content becomes, so the text fits the page outline: 2 on the canvas, 3 or 4 inside something that already has a heading.

muted.title: Quieter text
muted.description: Lower-emphasis text such as a note or caption. Still meets 7:1 contrast.

a11y.role: paragraph, with headings, lists, links, code and tables when the content has them

keyboard.does: reaches each link in the text, in order

wcag.notes: Line length capped at 68 characters and line height 1.6 (1.4.8 visual presentation). Plain language is the author's job; keep sentences short.

machine.identify: A div holding p elements. Read the text content.

props.content: Sameway renders the same accessible HTML for people and for agents.
